description: This file defines the JobCategoryDao class, which provides data access methods for the JobCategory entity within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions to retrieve, save, and delete job category records using Doctrine ORM query builders.

classes.name: JobCategoryDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for JobCategory entity, providing methods to perform CRUD operations and queries related to job categories.

methods.name: getJobCategoryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of JobCategory entities with optional sorting, pagination, and count.

methods.name: getJobCategoryById
methods.description: Fetches a JobCategory entity by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingJobCategoryIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing job categories from a list of IDs, used to check for existing records.

methods.name: saveJobCategory
methods.description: Persists a JobCategory entity to the database.

methods.name: deleteJobCategory
methods.description: Deletes job categories with specified IDs and returns the number of deleted records.
